findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with only `pass` as its body. StatefulDetectorHandler declares several abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`), so this class raises TypeError on instantiation. `Detector.detector_handler` calls `group_type.detector_handler(self)` with no guard, so any detector whose type is `metric_alert_fire` will crash in `process_detectors`. Before this PR the class was instantiable and returned an empty result list. Either keep it as a non-stateful handler or implement the abstract members. The PR description also says the new hook 'can be implemented', but it is declared `@abc.abstractmethod`, which forces every stateful handler to implement it, including ones that never emit occurrences. Making the hook optional with a default would avoid this.

findings.title: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe expects a fingerprint for the wrong group key
findings.body: The expected occurrence is built with `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", ...)`, so its fingerprint is `["<detector_id>:val1"]`. The assertion then calls `evaluate_group_key_value("group_key", 10, ...)`, and the hook builds the occurrence with fingerprint `["<detector_id>:group_key"]`. IssueOccurrence is a dataclass, so the equality check on `DetectorEvaluationResult` compares the fingerprint and fails. The fixture should be built with `"group_key"`.

findings.title: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring says evaluate 'returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`', but the signature and implementation now return a dict keyed by group key. The docstring should describe the dict return shape, since callers such as process_detectors now rely on it.

findings.title: Stale TODO says the handler will become stateful
findings.body: The comment 'This will be a stateful detector when we build that abstraction' is now wrong. The class already subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler in this same change, so the comment misleads readers about its current state.

findings.title: New abstract hook has no contract documentation
findings.body: build_occurrence_and_event_data is a new abstract extension point that every stateful detector must implement, but it has no docstring. It does not say when it is called (only on state changes to a non-OK priority), what event_data should contain (it is passed through to produce_occurrence_to_kafka), or whether the occurrence's fingerprint must match build_fingerprint(group_key). The resolve path uses build_fingerprint, so a mismatch would split issues. Subclass authors have no way to learn these rules from the code.

findings.title: Expected occurrences are built with values that do not match the evaluated values
findings.body: In test_results_on_change and test_dedupe the expected occurrence is built with value 6, but the evaluated values are 100 and 8. The helper ignores `value`, so the tests pass, but no test verifies that the hook receives the correct value and new_status from evaluate_group_key_value. A regression that drops or swaps those arguments would go undetected.
